main_text.p: facere poteft videri. Sic enim verba ejus habent, non cenfuiffe Solonem, cum certum modum ferendarū legum novarum posteris præfcriberet, thesmothetas legum curatores forte jam designatos, antequàm ad ineundum magistratum admitterentur, bis oportere examini subjici, in senatu primum, deinde in judicio, leges autem ipsas temerè, & sine ullo examine recipi æquum esse. Ecce, τὰς θεσμοθέτας, inquit, τὰς ἐπὶ τὰς νόμως κληρωθέντας [?] δὲς δοκιμασθέντας ἄρχειν. Res videtur clarissima, & fortitò thesmothetas, in numero ix-virūm erant, fuisse [illegible, ~2 letters]gnatos, & institutum à Solone magistratus esse. Verum obstat sententiæ huic illustris, atque, ut, quod res est, dicam, [illegible, ~3 letters]agabilis autoritas Aristotelis, viri [illegible, ~3 letters]tiam maximi, quæ extat eodem loco, ante notavi, politicorum lib. ii. [?]ae 10. Ibi namque de νομοθεσίας [?]is diflerens Philosophus perspicue verbis affirmat, Solonem leges [?]ntem non senatum modò Areopagum, sed morem etiam eligendi magistratus, uti ante in civitate fuerat, reliquisse, judicia autem cum plebe communicata, in quibus sortis esset usus, [?]gendum jus plebis, cum eorum ratio

page.notes: Left margin: small fragmentary note marks, mostly cut off at the edge, not legible. Right margin: a few faint marks at the top and near the middle, not legible. Foot of the page: stray marks only, not transcribed. Many words on the left edge are partly hidden by the margin notes; reconstructed readings are marked [?] or [illegible]. The Greek on lines 11–13 is only partly legible and should be checked against the scan. Possible printing errors: "diflerens" and "fortitò" are kept as printed.
